issues.title: deps: consume published @nuxtjp/localized-site 0.1.0
issues.body:
Replace the vendored UI tarball with the exact published @nuxtjp/ui 0.1.0 registry dependency, align the published peer requirements, regenerate the pnpm lock and update the package contract assertion.

Remove the obsolete workflow step that invokes pnpm pack before dependency installation. It packs this repository and triggers prepack with ajv unavailable; the public registry dependency no longer requires a vendor archive.

Validation: fresh-store frozen install, compliance verification, 49 tests, typecheck, production build, pack consumer and SSR passed. Independent review and actionlint v1.7.12 passed. Real GitHub policy and verification CI must pass before merge.

Only package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, test/layer-contract.test.ts and .github/workflows/verify.yml change. Documentation and user source changes are preserved.

issues.title: Clarify usage, outcomes and implementation scope
issues.body:
Readers can see what the repository enables, how to start, and which behavior is implemented. The README and usage guide retain declared dependency prerequisites and distinguish source verification from product or deployment acceptance.

Validation: local Markdown/link checks, source disclosure scan, unchanged license/notice, and existing OSS policy checks where defined. No package publication or deployment is requested.


Maintenance resolution: this repository remains archived after source consolidation. The canonical implementation is maintained in nuxtjp/nuxt-declarative-ui. This legacy-only documentation proposal is closed; no legacy release or dependency configuration is reinstated.

limits: Issue snapshots preserve observed API records, not unavailable external discussions.
This is preservation evidence, not deletion approval or registry availability.
